videos.t: Competing with a pipe cutter on wheels
videos.desc:
I had about 7 days to build a combat robot. I spent 2 days going around to shops to buy supplies, waited a few days for Amazon orders to come in, spent 2 days building, and then I competed with my robot.

I competed at Gulf Coast Makercon in Florida. I signed up late but after emailing the event organizers, they were nice enough to admit me.

videos.t: A freshman said he could beat me. We had 24 hours.
videos.desc:
In just one day, my friend Carlos (a freshman) and I (a junior) set out to build tiny DIY death machines AKA antweight combat robots. 

We only had 24 hours to design, build, and fight. Carlos may have been the rookie, but he’s scrappy-and I couldn’t risk losing to a freshman. After five brutal battles, only one of us walked away intact.
